g.text: C4 Architecture: Argo CD + Codefresh + Octopus — Deployment / Hosting Topology (Level 3)
Deployment topology — WHERE each part runs, and the "hosted control plane vs in-cluster runtime" split
{note: SaaS zone: you host nothing (Octopus, Codefresh, Git)

In-cluster: Argo runtime + Octopus gateway + app
